scientific_question: Does explicit actor-private information about fuel relative to the remaining mission help acquisition and retention of severity-conditioned PLAN / ABORT behaviour?

intervention.model_change: actor encoder agent_proj input width 1 -> 2 (the necessary input projection column); nothing else

comparator.reuse: valid preserved measurements reused; NOT rerun
comparator.comparison_class: cross-version, single-training-seed development comparison; a matched seed number does not promise identical initial weights or RNG trajectories after the input dimension changed

population_and_configuration.actor: unchanged two-layer GraphEncoder + ActionHead (agent input width 2)
population_and_configuration.fuel_damage_rtb_margin_note: unchanged environment parameter; NOT a multiplier in the new feature (factor 1.0)
population_and_configuration.other_settings: CLI defaults, identical to the comparator's run_config.json train_config except output_dir
population_and_configuration.evaluation_rounds: pre_update round + every 25 updates through 375 = 16 rounds
population_and_configuration.evaluation: deterministic semantic selection on the frozen DEVELOPMENT profile: 20 groups x CLEAN/MILD/SEVERE = 60 episodes per round, 960 planned; the legacy eval_episodes=8 field does not replace the manifest-defined profile

benchmark.held_out_check: full-manifest seeds vs [3000000, 3004500) with manifest_seed_overlap, before launch; the trainer repeats it at start-up

primary_endpoint.statistic: ten-base-cell macro P(ABORT | SEVERE) - P(ABORT | MILD)
primary_endpoint.population: matched metric-eligible immediate-FD development wakes of the certified ego
primary_endpoint.denominators: cell and group eligibility preserved; missing is not zero

mandatory_trajectory: the same endpoint at all 16 rounds, with directional (non-ABORT in MILD, ABORT in SEVERE) and reverse switches out of eligible groups, MILD and SEVERE probabilities separately; peak / first crossing are exploratory only
secondary: reward, utility, physical survival / return outcomes
training transition counts and credit diagnostics
immediate-FD vs post-FD-boundary vs ordinary wakes kept separate
feature distributions, signs, ranges and non-finite counts by phase and wake kind (severity reporting-only)
